title: Command palette navigation and in-editor find
naturalLanguageTask: Use Lynxtron Fiddle's command palette to open renderer.js, find the text 'hello-title' in that editor and verify a match is selected, close Find, then use the command palette to return to main.js and verify the main-process source is visible. Do not modify or save any file.

setup.readyAssertion: Lynxtron Fiddle is the foreground window, no Welcome or other modal dialog is open, and the unobstructed default Hello Lynxtron editors are visible

precondition: Lynxtron Fiddle shows the default Hello Lynxtron source editors and no modal dialog is open

steps.prompt: The command palette is visibly open with an unobstructed editable search input
The command palette has a selected result for renderer.js
The renderer.js editor is active and visibly contains the default ReactLynx source with 'Hello, Lynxtron!'

steps.target: the Find input for the current renderer.js editor

steps.prompt: The Find UI reports at least one match for 'hello-title' and an occurrence in renderer.js is selected or highlighted
The command palette is visibly open again with an unobstructed editable search input
The main.js editor is active and visibly contains the default main-process source including app.whenReady and LynxWindow
